verdict.rationale: Auth0's own documentation says users can sign in with social accounts such as Facebook or X. It lists social IDs and enterprise SSO among its supported login methods, and says Universal Login supports social, enterprise and custom identity providers. That covers the core of the story as a hosted, product-native capability. Missing for 10: an enumerated broad catalog of supported social/OAuth providers (only Facebook and X are named), explicit documentation that providers are enabled by dashboard configuration rather than code, and independent hands-on corroboration of the social-connection setup.
